notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch succeeded throughout (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome, bs4/lxml parsing of server-rendered HTML - no Playwright/CDP or Claude-in-Chrome needed). robots.txt has no blanket disallow and does not name any Claude/AI bot, so tier (a) was clear. TREE: Built via union of mega-menu (homepage nav) + each hub page's own rendered subcategory/filter strip (the 'Kategorie' facet, which resolves to dedicated pages with their own H1/canonical/count) + breadcrumb verification on every leaf (confirmed 'Heimtextilien > ... > <leaf>' or '... > Aufbewahrung > <leaf>' path on each fetched page) to resolve cases where the flattened mega-menu mixed sibling columns (e.g. raw nav wrongly attributed Kinderbettwaesche/Bettwaesche Winter&Sommer to 'Badtextilien' - breadcrumbs proved they actually sit under 'Bettwaesche'). No sitemap.xml was available (404). Where a hub page's own children summed exactly to the parent's displayed total (Aufbewahrung 441, Gardinen&Rollos 661, Rollos&Jalousien 57, Vorhaenge 465, Badtextilien 581), that confirmed the facet set was the true, exhaustive category partition. Stopped descending into pure size/firmness attribute filters (e.g. Bettwaesche 135x200/155x220/etc, Kopfkissen Mittelfeste/Feste/Weiche) since these are dimension/firmness variants of the same product type, not distinct categories - only genuinely distinct product-type children (e.g. Kopfkissenbezuege, Nackenrollen, Kinderbettwaesche) were kept as separate leaf rows. QTY: exact 'N Ergebnisse' result-count text rendered on each category/subcategory listing page, read directly from the server-rendered HTML (no JS execution needed - counts are present in the initial HTML response). EXCLUDED and why: 'Gardinenstangen & Zubehoer' (curtain rods/hardware, 139 items) - explicit textile.md hardware exclusion. 'Jalousien' (/jalousien) - same underlying page/content as 'Rollos & Jalousien' (/rollos-jalousien), duplicate URL alias, kept the canonical one only. 'Mehr Teppiche' (/empfehlung-teppiche, 641 items) - page title 'Mehr Teppiche bei Hoeffner' and slug 'empfehlung' (recommendation) indicate an algorithmic recommendation widget, not a genuine navigational category - excluded per View-All/Collection rule. 'Teppichzubehoer' (/teppichzubehoer, 1 item) - anti-slip rug underlay pad, an accessory not a textile floor-covering product itself - excluded. 'Taschen & Beutel' (/taschen-beutel, 103 items) - inspected product titles: shopping totes, handbags, cosmetic bags, travel/cooler bags (reisenthel brand) - fashion/personal-carrying bags, explicitly excluded by storage.md Sec.6 despite being listed under the site's own 'Aufbewahrung' (Storage) navigation. Bathroom/office/living-room storage furniture nodes (Badregale, Bueroschraenke, Rollcontainer, Aktenschraenke, Schraenke, Kommoden, Regale, Sideboards, Vitrinen, TV-Lowboards, Wohnwaende, etc.) were left out of both arrays - the site explicitly places them under the 'Moebel' (Furniture) navigation/Furniture.xlsx scope per storage.md Sec.21/27 furniture-boundary rule. Kopfkissen's firmness variants and Bettwaesche's pure size-dimension variants were also excluded as noted above (kept only distinct product-type children).
